technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with overbought conditions and bullish candlestick pattern, but weak intermediate trend structure and lack of ADX confirmation limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 96 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (325.28) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational defence contractor, though earnings in 96 days provides some distance from binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI-9 rising, AO cross-up, three white soldiers) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis, 26/100 fear-greed) offers tactical swing entry near support at 392.69.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 325.28 crisis, strong dollar), overbought technicals (RSI-14 72.08, Stoch 92.08) with weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 bearish, ADX non-trending), zero fundamental conviction, and price below 50/200 EMAs create high pullback risk that outweighs short-term momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI-9 rising, AO cross-up, three white soldiers) offers tactical appeal at support, but severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis 325.28, strong dollar) and overbought technicals (RSI-14 72.08, Stoch 92.08) with weak intermediate trend structure create asymmetric downside risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, extreme VIX) combined with overbought pullback risk (RSI-14 72.08, Stoch 92.08) could trigger sharp reversal below 392.69 support in crisis volatility environment.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see momentum entry, but fundamental/risk/sentiment agents heavily weight macro headwinds and overbought conditions; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding LMT with 47 existing Industrials positions (17.5% sector concentration); adding to existing position during sector saturation and macro crisis amplifies concentration risk without conviction edge.
